mechanism: Eslicarbazepine induces CYP3A4 metabolism of benazepril's active metabolite benazeprilat, potentially reducing ACE inhibitor efficacy; concurrent use may also increase hyperkalemia risk through additive effects on potassium handling.
action: Monitor blood pressure control and serum potassium levels; may require benazepril dose adjustment or alternative antihypertensive; ensure adequate renal function monitoring.
